    Boundary-generator covers of finite poset spaces #

    Every finite poset space is a strict quotient of an explicit object assembled from an empty-support ambient summand and principal-filter boundary summands. The construction records the elementary projective presentation on the target side of Iyama's realization. The remaining algebraic issue is to lift this strict quotient through the finite strict tau-category.

    abbrev MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryCoverCarrier {k T : Type u} [Field k] [PartialOrder T] (Y : Obj k T) :
    Type u

    The carrier of the boundary-generator cover. The first coordinate is an empty-support copy of the ambient space. The second coordinate contains one copy of Y_t for every boundary point t.

              theorem MagnitudeConjecture.PosetSpace.boundaryCoverMap_subspace_surjective {k T : Type u} [Field k] [Fintype T] [PartialOrder T] (Y : Obj k T) (r : T) :
              Function.Surjective ⇑(LinearMap.codRestrict (Y.subspace r) ((boundaryCoverMap Y).linear.domRestrict ((boundaryCover Y).subspace r)) ⋯)
